title: @export flag changes large integers
body:
### Tested versions

- Spotted on 4.6.3.stable
- Not able to reproduce in the clean project.
- After a few attempts (few succesful) to reproduce in the original, much larger project, the bug stopped appearing

- I'm using GodotSteam GDExtension, as well as many addons.

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8097) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.88 GiB memory

### Issue description

I am working with GodoSteam GDExtension. I was keeping steam id as an `@export` variable, however when I entered my steam ID the last few numbers changed. I can't edit the spinbox as well. When i removed `@export` flag the problem was fixed

```gdscript
@export var export_id : int = 76561198431480771 # -> Changed to 76561198431480800 (value seen in editor)
var id : int = 76561198431480771 # -> Stayed 76561198431480771
```

### Steps to reproduce

Couldn't reproduce on a clean project or even clean scene

Code that i tried:
```gdscript
extends Node

@export var export_id : int = 76561198431480771 # -> Changes to 76561198431480800
var id : int = 76561198431480771 # -> stays 76561198431480771

func _ready() -> void:
	print(id) -> 76561198431480771
	print(export_id) -> 76561198431480771
```

While it kept appearing it was persistant. As i mentioned before, undoing the bug fix made it appear again, however after trying on a clear scene, the bug stopped appearing in the original scene as well.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Couldn't reproduce on a clean project or even clean scene
